hooks.text: 每波获得随机地块并旋转铺设敌人路线
hooks.excerpt: Monster Tiles TD features a unique tower defense mechanic where you manually rotate and place a randomly generated tile after each wave to control the enemy path.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三十五种怪物塔可进化并触发站位协同
hooks.excerpt: Over 35 monster tower types to build, each with unique skills and synergies. Evolve monsters to greater forms for powerful stat and skill bonuses.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 在线模式具有付费取胜问题。

excerpts.excerpt: the online gamemode is pay to win
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 成长与付费系统鼓励通过消费缓解刷取。

excerpts.excerpt: a progression system that feels built to encourage mtx purchases to mitigate the grind.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多个页面持续展示现金商店广告。

excerpts.excerpt: There is a cash shop ad on nearly every page in the game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 基础塔类型同质化严重。

excerpts.excerpt: There are like 40 towers but they are really just 4 towers some of which have higher stats.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: why on earth is there no way to save the game?
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 10 for the grind to become unfun.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 塔防玩法兼具乐趣和深度。

excerpts.excerpt: An enjoyable and depth tower defence game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 基础玩法扎实且免费内容具有乐趣。

excerpts.excerpt: Solid gameplay, plenty of fun to be had for free.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分模式统一起点的设计很好。

excerpts.excerpt: having some of the game modes put all players at an even starting point is a great choice
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
